items.q: and we got a bass player by the name of Nick Fenton, as I told you, and this is how we started rehearsing.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Yeah, well that's evident by size, you know. But Harold was a marvelous cook, and so we would just pool our money and give Harold -- we would buy the groceries and Harold would cook, you know. And this -- I think this is why -- this is how we started rehearsing together, Lester, Harold, and Shad Collins used to come around all the time. And when they -- Shad had played with Basie also, and we got a bass player by the name of Nick Fenton, as I told you, and this is how we started rehearsing. We just…
